_about: Hoshigaki: strings of peeled persimmons drying under the eaves in late fall (HoshigakiRules; HoshigakiLayer in 3D, HoshigakiView in the flat view; pictures: HoshigakiArt, PlaceholderArt "hoshigaki"). They hang from day days[0] to day days[1] of the seasons listed, outdoors only, under the farmhouse's front eave and under the front eave of the village houses whose hash of their cell falls below village_share. They are taken in on a day whose weather look is one of `taken_in` (rain, a storm, snow). `dry`: the days hung (0 on the first day) until they are fully dried (`full_days`); the picture's stage is the dried share in `stages` steps, each with its three tones lit from the upper left (light, base, dark), a fruit size in pixels for the 3D picture (`big`: w, h) and the flat one (`small`), from fresh bright orange to a shrunken deep red-brown with a pale sugar bloom (`bloom`). `fruit`: how many persimmons a string carries (fruit[0] .. fruit[1], from a hash of its spot). `eave`: the 3D strings along a front eave: `inset` in from each end, `gap` between strings (units), a `skip` share left bare, `door_margin` kept clear each side of a door cell, at most `most` a house, tucked `tuck` under the soffit. `flat`: the flat view's strings under the painted roof's bottom eave (pixels: inset, gap, skip, door margin; at most `most_fruit` persimmons on a flat string, so it hangs about a cell). `sway`: a slow swing with the wind (data/wind.json, 0 .. 1), none in dead calm, `max_deg` at a gale; `rate_hz` swings a second, `rate_gain` how much the wind quickens them; `flat.shift_px` the flat view's sideways shift at a full swing. `pixel_size`: the 3D picture's world units a pixel. `force`: `--hoshigaki` hangs them on outdoors whatever the date and weather, `days` hung when the date is outside the window (`--hoshigaki=N`: N days hung). Balance numbers are ours.
